message.content:
I’m happy to help you plan your trip!  
To give you an accurate airfare estimate for a **business‑class** ticket from **ORD (O’Hare International Airport)** to **SVP (Saint Vincent Airport)** on **July 14, 2026**, I’ll need a bit more detail:

| What’s needed | Why it matters |
|---------------|----------------|
| Number of passengers | Fares vary per person & seat availability |
| Preferred airline(s) | Some carriers offer better business‑class deals |
| Any frequent‑flyer miles/points | Can reduce cash outlay |
| Desired departure time | Peak vs off‑peak pricing differences |

Once I have those details, I can pull up current inventory and prices from our partner airlines and present you with the best options—plus any ancillary services (e.g., lounge passes, extra baggage).  

Let me know what works best for you, and we’ll lock down the perfect itinerary!
